If T3519 is running, the UE must include the stored SUCI from the previous attempt.

depends_on: UE having no valid 5G NAS security context
dependencies.reason: If no valid security context, the full REGISTRATION REQUEST must be included in the subsequent SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.
AMF actions (common procedures, accept/reject) depend on receiving the request.
UE actions (state change, context storage, sending COMPLETE) depend on receiving ACCEPT.
Sending REGISTRATION COMPLETE is dependent on receiving specific IEs in the ACCEPT message.

depends_on: Receipt of REGISTRATION COMPLETE (if T3550 started)
dependencies.reason: AMF stops T3550 and considers certain information valid only after receiving REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
UE actions (state change, context deletion, timer start, retry/fallback) depend on receiving REJECT and its cause code.
Retrying after T3510 timeout or abnormal reject requires the counter to be less than 5.
Fallback actions (delete context, start T3502, PLMN search) occur when the counter reaches 5.

timeouts.timeout_condition: UE starts timer T3510 after sending REGISTRATION REQUEST.
timeouts.timeout_action: If T3510 expires before receiving REGISTRATION ACCEPT or REJECT, UE aborts procedure, increments counter, starts T3511 (if counter < 5) or deletes context/starts T3502 (if counter == 5). See 5.5.1.2.7 c).

timeouts.timeout_condition: UE starts timer T3511 after T3510 expiry or abnormal reject (if attempt counter < 5).
timeouts.timeout_action: When T3511 expires, the registration procedure for initial registration shall be restarted, if still required.

timeouts.timeout_condition: UE starts timer T3502 when registration attempt counter reaches 5 (if T3502 value is not zero).
timeouts.timeout_action: When T3502 expires, UE may re-attempt registration or perform PLMN selection based on implementation.

timeouts.timeout_condition: UE starts timer T3346 upon receiving REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #22 and a valid T3346 value.
timeouts.timeout_action: When T3346 expires or is stopped, the initial registration procedure is started if still needed.

timeouts.timeout_condition: AMF starts timer T3550 after sending REGISTRATION ACCEPT containing specific IEs requiring acknowledgement.
timeouts.timeout_action: If T3550 expires before REGISTRATION COMPLETE is received: Retransmit REGISTRATION ACCEPT and restart T3550 (up to 4 retransmissions). On 5th expiry, abort procedure, enter 5GMM-REGISTERED, keep old+new GUTI temporarily. See 5.5.1.2.8 c).

timeouts.timeout_condition: UE starts timer T3519 when sending REGISTRATION REQUEST with SUCI (if T3519 not already running).
timeouts.timeout_action: While T3519 is running, UE includes the stored SUCI in subsequent REGISTRATION REQUEST messages.

timeouts.timeout_condition: UE starts timer T3526 upon receiving REGISTRATION ACCEPT/REJECT with Rejected NSSAI containing cause 'S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached' and a back-off timer value.
timeouts.timeout_action: When T3526 expires, remove the associated S-NSSAI from the rejected NSSAI list for 'maximum number of UEs reached'.
